subject: general
question: Due to burning of _____ inside the combustion chamber, particles are left behind in CI engine.
solution:
The correct answer is __Lubricating oil**(Option 1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lubricating oil__ is used inside the combustion chamber of CI engines.
 
• Lubricating oil helps reduce friction between engine parts.
 
• Due to the combustion process, small particles are left behind.
 
• The presence of these particles can affect engine performance if not properly managed.
 
• Proper use of lubricating oil ensures smooth operation of the engine.
 
• It also helps in heat dissipation within the engine components.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydraulic Oil:**

 
 
• Hydraulic oil is used in hydraulic systems for power transmission.
 
• It is not used inside the combustion chamber of CI engines.
 
 
 
• **Petrol:**
 
 
• Petrol is mainly used as a fuel in spark ignition engines.
 
• It is not used in CI engines, which typically rely on diesel.
 
 
 
• **Coolant:**
 
 
• Coolant is used to maintain the engine temperature and prevent overheating.
 
• It does not leave particles inside the combustion chamber.
